messages.subject: annotation.csv file to read MaxQuant output for fractionated label free DDA experiment
parts:
Hello,

I am sorry for such a simple question, but I am having a problem with constructing annotation.csv file for my experiment, to read output I got from MaxQuant.

My experiment consist from 3 controls: Control A, Control B, Control C
and 3 knockdown samples: knockdown A, knockdown B, knockdown C
Each sample was fractionated into 10 fractions, so I have 60 fractions in total which were run on a MS/MS for a label free analysis giving me 60 raw files.
In MaxQuant experiment design file fractions were named 1 - 60 so we have Control A fraction 1-10, Control B fraction 11-20 etc.

I was wondering how do I create an annotation.csv file to make sure MSStats gets my experiment design right.
In other words I am not entirely sure what should I write in
Condition, BioReplicate and Experiment columns.

I will apprecieate any help!
Olga

messages.author: df9ba0266a9a081f
messages.subject: Re: annotation.csv file to read MaxQuant output for fractionated label free DDA experiment
parts:
Olga,

1. 'Condition' column : control or knockdown
2. 'BioReplicate' column : unique ID for sample. here it seems 6 different sample, so, 1 to 6 for control A, control B, control C, knockdown A, knockdown B, knockdown C.
   - But, if 'A' for control and 'A' for knockout is the same,  1 to 3 for A, B, C
3. Experiment : same as raw file ids.
4. Raw.file : file id. so 60 unique raw file names.(60 rows are needed.)

If you need further help, please let us know.

-Meena
